The {{Term/Store|Giant Horse||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring [[Creature]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|'''Giant Horse'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Giant Horse'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Quests|
{{BotW Quest
 |name= Hunt for the Giant Horse
 |type= Side Quest
 |giver= [[Straia]]
 |location= [[Mounted Archery Camp]]
}}
}}
{{Compendium/Extract|Giant Horse}}
The Giant Horse is a massive [[Wild Horse]] with charcoal-colored fur. Its mane and tail are a distinctly orange color, and it is found in the [[Taobab Grassland]] among a herd of regularly-sized Horses. While it is the last of its breed, the Giant Horse is considerably stronger than other Horses.<ref name="Compendium">{{Cite|This giant horse is the last of its kind. Its physical capabilities completely overshadow those of regular horses, but its temperament is extremely wild. Only a truly skilled rider can train, or even catch, this beast of a mount. This is a horse that chooses its rider.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> Due to its wild temperament, only skilled riders can tame it.<ref name="Compendium"/>

Link must capture the Giant Horse in order to complete the "[[Hunt for the Giant Horse]]" [[Side Quest]], given by [[Straia]] at the [[Mounted Archery Camp]]. Straia and [[Jini]] came to the [[Faron Grasslands]] to see the Giant Horse, but have been unable to reach it due to [[Monster]]s in the area.<ref>{{Cite|We'd heard that there was a {{Color BotW|Red|giant horse}} living in this region. Apparently it can't be found anywhere else... That was all we needed to hear! We headed this way to investigate right away! The really big horse in this region is likely part of a rare, local species. However, with all the monsters roaming around, we simply can't go any farther. To be so close to discovery...|Straia|BotW}}</ref> Straia asks Link to catch the Giant Horse on their behalf.<ref>{{Cite|Just from looking at you, I'd guess that you're an adventurer, right? You certainly look strong. Hrm... Hey, how would you like to go and catch a {{Color BotW|Red|giant horse}} for us?|Straia|BotW}}</ref> Once Link has mounted the Giant Horse and southed it, he must ride past two [[Lynel]]s in order to return to the Mounted Archery Camp. Seeing the Giant Horse, Straia determines that it is an endemic species, <ref>{{Cite|That horse... It's huge... I've never seen one that big! That is definitely an endemic species!|Straia|BotW}}</ref> He thanks Link for assisting in their research and gives him a [[Silver Rupee]] as a reward.<ref>{{Cite|It's definitely different seeing something with your own eyes rather than just reading about it. Thank you! This is to thank you for helping with our investigation!|Straia|BotW}}</ref>

Registering the Giant Horse at a [[Stable]] equips this [[Horse]] with a [[Bridle]] and [[Saddle]] that are part of the [[Giant Horse Gear]] set of [[Horse Gear]].<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 161}}</ref> However, if [[Link]] tries to change into a different piece of Horse Gear, Stable workers will refuse, stating that they do not have anything large enough to fit it.<ref>{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled... I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}</ref>

The Giant Horse cannot gallop and has poor speed, but it is one of the strongest steeds available as compensation. Though its speed is ranked poorly, it does travel considerably faster than other Horses of the same speed stat as it takes much larger steps.

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Giant Horse}}
{{Stub|TotK}}
The Giant Horse can be found on [[Hateno Beach]]. Alternatively, if Link had the Giant Horse registered in {{BotW|-}}, its save data will be carried over.

==Trivia==
*The Giant Horse bears a resemblance to [[Ganondorf's Horse]], which was also a large Horse with black fur and an orange mane.
*The Giant Horse, the [[White Horse]], the [[Giant White Stallion]], the [[Lord of the Mountain|Satori]], and [[Patricia]] are the only individuals to get their own unique entries in the [[Hyrule Compendium]] separate from the rest of their species.
* The Giant Horse is one of nine rideable [[Creature]]s in {{BotW|-}}. The other eight are the [[Horse]], the White Horse, the Lord of the Mountain, the [[Mountain Buck]], the [[Mountain Doe]], the [[Stalhorse]], the [[Honeyvore Bear]], and the [[Grizzlemaw Bear]].
